name: Red Hat OpenShift Foundations
description: Enterprise Kubernetes platform methodology covering cloud-native application development, SRE-driven platform operations, defense-in-depth security, and comprehensive observability on Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

narratives.name: Method Overview
narratives.description: Red Hat OpenShift Foundations methodology narrative.

narrativeContexts.narrativeElementName: Act I: The Hero and the Problem
narrativeContexts.context: Platform engineers and developers face enterprise container platform challenges requiring developer velocity, operational reliability, security compliance, and system observability across diverse hybrid cloud infrastructure.

narrativeContexts.narrativeElementName: Act II: The Guide and the Plan
narrativeContexts.context: Red Hat OpenShift provides an integrated internal developer platform with self-service golden paths, SRE-driven automation, zero-trust security guardrails, and unified observability stacks that reduce cognitive load and accelerate delivery.

narrativeContexts.narrativeElementName: Act III: Call to Action and Success
narrativeContexts.context: Teams adopt OpenShift Foundations practices progressively from manual operations through automated self-service, achieving AI-assisted developer platforms, fleet-wide orchestration, adaptive security posture, and correlated multi-tenant observability at enterprise scale.
